bio: The culinary classics have no secrets for Koen Devos, whose team can be relied on to add the odd contemporary touch to pedigree dishes. You can expect a repertory of premium produce such as lobster and partridge and recipes that show a reverence for authentic flavours, albeit with modern side dishes. Chef Devos is a horse lover, as you will quickly discover when you admire the elegant interior of this lavish villa. The B&B offers a view of the horses grazing from the windows....
